      Button "Save workout" size=large fill=#FFC6FF00 color=#FF0A0A0A radius=20 onTap={history=append(history,{"date":today(),"name":"Push A","rating":rating,"summary":summary,"exercises":exercises}); active=false; exercises=[]; elapsed=0; toast "Workout saved"; go today}
      Button.ghost "Discard" onTap={open discardAsk}
  ConfirmDialog#discardAsk "Discard this workout?" "It will not be saved to your history."
    Button.ghost "Cancel" onTap={close}
    Button.destructive "Discard" onTap={active=false; exercises=[]; elapsed=0; close; go today}
